# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.44

Audited RX Profile Sync reliability and batch-operation update dated 2026-07-30.

## Added

- Select multiple RX records in Back Office and synchronize up to 100 checked records in one confirmed batch.
- Export completed RX Profile Sync audit history as CSV with user, timestamp, RX/Patient references, field, and before/after IDs.

## Fixed

- Patient Transport and Pharmacy Transport values use explicit field persistence and are re-read before the operation reports success.
- Pharmacy synchronization retains its existing working update path.
- Blank Patient profile assignments and empty field selections make no RX changes.

## Audit and safety

- Master administrators only.
- Every changed RX receives its own RX History and Audit Log entry, including batch operations.
- No database migration, workflow-action configuration, automatic synchronization, or business-data rewrite.
- Validate on the test server before any production update.
